title: Mapping-space fibres of a free dg-cell attachment
statement:
Use the small dg categories, cofibrant objects and localization at quasi-equivalences of [lem-coef-dgcat-model-structure], and derived mapping spaces as in [lem-coef-cosimplicial-frame-mapping]. Let $\mathcal B$ be cofibrant and let $I$ be a small set. For each $i\in I$, choose objects $s_i,t_i\in\mathcal B$, an integer $n_i$, and a closed element $z_i\in\mathcal B(s_i,t_i)^{n_i+1}$. Form $\mathcal B[e_i]$ by freely adjoining arrows $e_i:s_i\to t_i$ of degree $n_i$ with $d(e_i)=z_i$, using the word construction of [lem-coef-dgcat-free-cell-calculus], with no additional relations. Then $\mathcal B\to\mathcal B[e_i]$ is a cofibration and $\mathcal B[e_i]$ is cofibrant. For any small dg category $\mathcal E$ and strict dg functor $F:\mathcal B\to\mathcal E$, the homotopy fibre over $F$ of
$$\operatorname{Map}_{\mathrm{qe}}(\mathcal B[e_i],\mathcal E)\longrightarrow\operatorname{Map}_{\mathrm{qe}}(\mathcal B,\mathcal E)$$
is naturally equivalent to
$$\prod_{i\in I}\operatorname{Path}_{0,F(z_i)}\operatorname{Map}_{\mathbf D(\mathbf Z)}\bigl(\mathbf Z[-n_i-1],\mathcal E(Fs_i,Ft_i)\bigr).$$
Here $\mathbf D(\mathbf Z)$ is the enhanced localization of cochains at quasi-isomorphisms, with cochain convention as in [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and $\mathbf Z[m]$ has $\mathbf Z$ in degree $-m$, and $\operatorname{Path}_{a,b}(S)$ is the homotopy fibre of the endpoint map $S^{\Delta^1}\to S\times S$ over $(a,b)$; a closed degree-$n_i+1$ element gives the indicated point. The product of an empty family is a point. The comparison is natural under dg functors and under homotopy coherent variation of $F$.
